title: Batch terminal transcript updates
goal: Avoid repeated SwiftUI state mutations and repeated transcript-limit scans when one terminal command returns many output lines.
context: TerminalScreen currently appends each output line individually. Each append recomputes retained transcript bytes and may trim the array, so a large command response repeats this work for every line. Batch the command and output lines into one transcript append while preserving the existing 500-line and 256-KiB retention limits.
forbidden_changes: Do not change command execution, output ordering, stderr styling, clear semantics, or destructive-command confirmation.
Do not increase the existing transcript line or byte limits.
Do not modify Chat, Agent runtime/provider behavior, Orb, or startup handling.
Do not claim measured device performance improvement without device measurements.
acceptance_criteria: Successful non-clear commands append command and newly returned output lines as one batch.
Command errors append the command and error as one batch.
The clear command still clears the transcript without leaving a visible clear command line.
The 500-line and 256-KiB transcript retention limits remain enforced.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Review success, stderr, error, clear, and retention paths.
Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: Revert the single task commit if output ordering, clear behavior, or retention limits regress.
